constants.name: MaxRestarts
constants.description:
Maximum number of child restarts for a single command before giving up

Bounds the SOCKET-NOT-OPEN / dead-child restart path so that a command that deterministically breaks the command channel (e.g. the lazy-init first-call latency on a `webhook_register)` fails after this many restarts instead of respawning the child process forever at 100% CPU.
